patch_description: Add a final layer of independent RY rotations after the skip-2 CRZ entangling layer. This introduces a non-commuting rotation axis after the last entangling layer, increasing the expressivity of the circuit's output state without adding extra entangling depth. Based on prior experiments, alternating RY-entangle-RY-entangle-RY patterns tend to improve both train and validation accuracy while keeping the circuit within reasonable depth (small +8 gate addition). This should help push accuracy higher while the shared-parameter skip layer already helps limit overfitting; we monitor the gap and can further share params if it grows too large.
